description: ORES - compteurs communicants et compteurs smart (électricité et gaz) is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ORES. Afin de mesurer l’impact de ses Open Data, Ores est intéressée d’être tenue informée des réutilisations qui seront faites des données mises à disposition. Données à fin 07/2026. Nom du rapport: Compteurs communicants: nombre de demandes des clients Niveau d'agrégation: Le dataset contient des. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal lists 2 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Energie. Its keywords are ore, électricité, gaz, client, communicer, smart. The portal shows 9 records. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
